g.text: 1. POST webhook payment.succeeded (HMAC signature, event id)
2. Verify signature and timestamp; drop duplicate event ids
5. One transaction: PENDING_PAYMENT to PAID + outbox event
7. Async inference request: anonymised features only
8. Suggestion AI_PROPOSED (never final), merged with the rules floor
9. Case enters the queue ordered by urgency, flagged AI_PROPOSED
10. Clinician accepts; consultation starts (video or voice); audit event written
